manual_counting_rule: Do not increase any outcome metric until a non-owner public GitHub issue includes permission, contains no private data, and passes the external reviewer evidence gate.

prioritized_next_send.reviewer_profile: AI engineer, mentor, or ML systems reviewer

purpose: Route external reviewers to the shortest evidence path for their available time and background, so public feedback can become resume-countable only after the evidence gate accepts it.
resume_safe_summary: Published a reviewer quickstart router with 5 evidence paths mapped to feedback, confirmed-use, reproducible-run, AI-review, and business-case outcome metrics while preserving zero current claims.
